title: view file schema override support and demo toggle

goal.text: view file schema override support and demo toggle

requirements.summary: 为 super-json-editor 增加 view file schema override 支持，并在 demo 的 schema-authoring 场景提供 View on/off toggle。
acceptanceCriteria: View file schema 与 default schema 叠加得到 resolved schema，view 同字段覆盖 default，default 新字段在 view 未覆盖时继承。
在 view 模式编辑 schema 只写入 view file，不影响 default schema。
Demo 中 View 按钮固定显示 View/视图，开启后保持可见按下态；初始 view 与 default 完全一致。
相关 focused tests 与 app build 通过。

tasks.title: Use the planning skill to refine the request and append executable tasks
tasks.detail: Use the built-in planning skill to refine the request and append executable tasks into `tasks`. If the current request is still unclear, fill `requirements` first as part of the planning output, then append executable tasks. Keep the pre-seeded activation task and only append downstream work. Recommended planning skill: the built-in planning skill.

tasks.title: Enter process.active
tasks.detail: After the planning task appends the executable tasks, move the plan into `process.active` and continue execution from the refined task list. If Goal Mode is enabled for this project, start Goal Mode when entering `process.active` and use `Using claw-kit, update plan, follow returned workflowGuidance，finish your goal：view file schema override support and demo toggle` as the goal objective.

tasks.title: Write the implementation plan and record the view file schema layering decisions
tasks.detail: Create a plan doc under docs/plans that captures the agreed model: default schema + view file schema = resolved schema, default writes stay on the default schema, view writes stay on the active view file, and the demo site adds a toolbar toggle beside Raw/Edit.

tasks.title: Implement schema host view file layering and directed write support
tasks.detail: Extend the schema host contract and EditorShell schema authoring flow so hosts can expose resolved schema reads plus write-target-aware updates for default and view layers without breaking existing hosts.

tasks.title: Add merge helper and tests for resolved schema behavior
tasks.detail: Introduce a small schema merge helper for default schema plus view schema overrides, export it, and cover the layering behavior with focused tests.

tasks.title: Add demo-site view toggle and in-memory view file simulation
tasks.detail: Update the demo app to simulate view files for the schema authoring scenario and render a toolbar toggle beside Raw/Edit so users can switch between default and view schema modes.

tasks.title: Run targeted verification and close out the task
tasks.detail: Run the relevant Vitest coverage for schema authoring, view layering, and demo toggle behavior, then summarize the outcome and remaining risks before closeout.

keyDecisions: 个人视图文件作为 view schema override，不引入冲突概念；同字段以 view 为主。
view schema 初始为空对象，resolve 时叠加 default schema，避免未编辑时切换 view 产生视觉差异。
schema 写入由 activeSchemaLayer/writeTarget 决定：default 写 default，view 写 active view file。
Demo View 控制采用稳定 on/off toggle：文本不在 View/Default 间切换，状态由 aria-pressed 与 is-active 表达。

retrospective.summary: 完成 view file schema override 支持、schema 写入目标分层、resolve helper、demo View toggle 与测试覆盖；修复了 View 初始切换不应改变视图、以及按钮开启后缺少保持按下视觉态的问题。验证通过 focused Vitest 与 npm run build:app。
